audited_product_bundle.query: Under contemporary Swiss case law, when is a contractual non-compete clause (Konkurrenzklausel / clause de non-concurrence) valid and enforceable against a former employee?
query_variants: non-compete clause Swiss Federal Supreme Court requirements

answer.prose: Under contemporary Swiss case law, a contractual non-compete clause is valid and enforceable against a former employee only if it is limited in time, geography, and scope, justified by a legitimate employer interest worthy of protection, and remains proportionate to the employee's actual activities [CH-2020-FR-001] (BGer 4A_123/2020: "Une clause de non-concurrence n'est valable que si elle est limitee dans le temps, dans l'espace et quant au contenu, et si elle est justifiee par un interet digne de protection de l'employeur; elle doit rester proportionnee a l'activite reelle du cocontractant"). A clause capturing all employees irrespective of actual competition risk violates the proportionality requirement; the decisive factors are the concrete function and access to customer data [CH-2019-DE-014] (BGer 4A_210/2019: "Eine Konkurrenzklausel, die generell alle Arbeitnehmerinnen und Arbeitnehmer ohne Rucksicht auf die tatsachliche Konkurrenzgefahr erfasst, verstoesst gegen das Massgebot der Verhaeltnismaessigkeit und ist unverbindlich. Massgebend ist die konkrete Funktion und die Zugangsberechtigung zu Kundendaten"). The employer must prove a concrete risk of competition, and the clause is not enforceable against an employee who had no access to confidential information [CH-2022-IT-007] (BGer 4A_7/2022: "la clausola di non concorrenza non e opponibile al dipendente che non aveva alcun accesso a informazioni riservate; l'eccezione di assenza di concorrenza reale prevale sulla clausola. Il datore di lavoro deve provare il rischio concreto"). If the employer waives the waiting-period compensation (Karenzentschädigung) during the notice period, the entire clause becomes unenforceable and cannot be subsequently cured, even if all other requirements are met [CH-2021-DE-042] (BGer 4A_42/2021: "Der Verzicht des Arbeitgebers auf die Karenzentschaedigung waehrend der Kündigungsfrist fuehrt zur Unverbindlichkeit der ganzen Konkurrenzklausel; eine nachtraegliche Heilung ist ausgeschlossen"). No non-compete clause is permissible for apprentices, as the protection of the apprentice's livelihood outweighs the training company's economic interest [CH-2018-DE-031] (BGer 4A_31/2018: "Keine Konkurrenzklausel zulaessig im Arbeitsverhaeltnis mit einem Lehrling; die Interessenabwaegung fuehrt zum Ausschluss jedes Verbots"). A previously more lenient approach requiring only a protectworthy employer interest without strict proportionality review has been abandoned by recent case law [CH-2016-FR-088] (TF 4A_88/2016: "Cette approche souple a ete abandonnee par la jurisprudence recente").
